# Prep/Cleaning

```{r,message=F}

wd = getwd() #working directory

# read file
data = read.csv("E2_data.csv")

```

## False Alarms - unrelated distractor words

```{r}

# old_new
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    studied_vs_lure = recode(wordtype, 'aloud' = "studied", "silent" = 'studied'),
    old_new = ifelse(oldanswer == "new", 0, 1))

# unrelated distractor words only
unrelated_distractors <- data %>% 
  filter(wordtype == "unrelated" | wordtype == "unrelated-lure")

# false alarm rate for unrelated distractor words
FA_rate = mean(unrelated_distractors$old_new)

# calculate FA rates separately for 'lure' type unrelated distractors
unrelated_distractors_wide <- unrelated_distractors %>% 
  group_by(wordtype,randomID) %>%
  summarize(mean_old = mean(old_new),
            sd_old = sd(old_new))

unrelated_distractors_wide %>%
  group_by(wordtype) %>%
  summarize(mean = mean(mean_old),
            sd = sd(mean_old))

# calculate significance for lures vs. non lures (unrelated distractors)
distractor_anova = aov_ez(
  data = unrelated_distractors,
  id = "randomID",
  dv = "old_new",
  within = "wordtype",
  include_aov = TRUE
)

print(distractor_anova)

```
# Proportion Old - Presented and Critical Lures

```{r}

# make wide data - 4 rows per sub - Presented and Critical Lures only
four_row_data <- data %>%
  filter(studied_vs_lure == "studied" | studied_vs_lure == "lure") %>%
  group_by(randomID, studied_vs_lure,production) %>%
  summarise(mean_old = mean(old_new),
            n = length(old_new)) %>%
  ungroup()

# make even wider data - 1 row per sub - Presented and Critical Lures only
one_row_data <- four_row_data %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = randomID,
              names_from = c(production,studied_vs_lure),
              names_sep = "_",
              values_from = mean_old,
              values_fn = mean
  )

# Omnibus ANOVA: Aloud/Silent x Studied/Lure 
anova_model = aov_ez(
  data = four_row_data,
  id = "randomID",
  dv = "mean_old",
  within = c("production","studied_vs_lure"),
  include_aov = TRUE
)

print(anova_model)

# Production effect for studied words
t.test(one_row_data$aloud_studied, one_row_data$silent_studied, paired=TRUE, var.equal = TRUE)
cohen.d(one_row_data$aloud_studied, one_row_data$silent_studied, paired=TRUE, var.equal = TRUE)

# Production effect for lures
t.test(one_row_data$aloud_lure, one_row_data$silent_lure, paired=TRUE, var.equal = TRUE)
cohen.d(one_row_data$aloud_lure, one_row_data$silent_lure, paired=TRUE, var.equal = TRUE)


```

# Descriptives - Proportion Old

```{r}

# Descriptive statistics
four_row_data %>% group_by(production) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(mean_old),
            sd = sd(mean_old),
            se = sd/sqrt(80)) %>%
  ungroup()

four_row_data %>% group_by(studied_vs_lure) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(mean_old),
            sd = sd(mean_old),
            se = sd/sqrt(80)) %>%
  ungroup()

four_row_data %>% group_by(production,studied_vs_lure) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(mean_old),
            sd = sd(mean_old),
            se = sd/sqrt(80)) %>%
  ungroup()


```


# Recognition and Familiarity

```{r}

# Count number of Rem/Know/New responses and calculate R/F measures
rk_data <- data %>%
  filter(studied_vs_lure == "studied" | studied_vs_lure == "lure") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(randomID, studied_vs_lure,production),
              names_from = answer,
              values_from = aloud_colour,
              values_fn = length,
              values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_recog = remember/(remember+new+know),
         prop_familiar = know/(new+know)) %>%
  mutate(prop_familiar = replace_na(prop_familiar, 0))

# make longer data for ANOVA
rk_data_longer <- rk_data %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c("prop_recog","prop_familiar"),
              names_to = "RF",
              values_to = "proportion_responses"
)

# make wider data for t-test
rk_data_wider <- rk_data_longer %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = randomID,
              names_from = c(production, studied_vs_lure,RF),
              names_sep = "_",
              values_from = proportion_responses,
              values_fn = mean
  )


# Omnibus 3 way ANOVA: Studied/Lure x R/F x Aloud/Silent
rk_omnibus_model = aov_ez(
  data = rk_data_longer,
  id = "randomID",
  dv = "proportion_responses",
  within = c("production","studied_vs_lure","RF"),
  include_aov = TRUE
)

print(rk_omnibus_model)

# 2 way ANOVA: R/F x Aloud/Silent for Studied
rk_studied_model = aov_ez(
  data = filter(rk_data_longer,studied_vs_lure=="studied"),
  id = "randomID",
  dv = "proportion_responses",
  within = c("production","RF"),
  include_aov = TRUE
)

print(rk_studied_model)

# no followup due to ns interaction


# 2 way ANOVA: R/F x Aloud/Silent for Lures
rk_lures_model = aov_ez(
  data = filter(rk_data_longer,studied_vs_lure=="lure"),
  id = "randomID",
  dv = "proportion_responses",
  within = c("production","RF"),
  include_aov = TRUE
)

print(rk_lures_model)

# no followup due to ns interaction

```

# Descriptives - Recog/Familiarity

```{r}

# Descriptive statistics - collapsing across RF
rk_data_longer %>% group_by(studied_vs_lure,production) %>%
  summarise(mean.rf = mean(proportion_responses),
            sd.rf = sd(proportion_responses),
            se.rf = sd.rf/sqrt(80)
            ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Descriptive statistics - collapsing across production
rk_data_longer %>% group_by(studied_vs_lure,RF) %>%
  summarise(mean.rf = mean(proportion_responses),
            sd.rf = sd(proportion_responses),
            se.rf = sd.rf/sqrt(80)
            ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Table 2
rk_data_longer %>% group_by(studied_vs_lure,production,RF) %>%
  summarise(mean.rf = mean(proportion_responses),
            sd.rf = sd(proportion_responses),
            se.rf = sd.rf/sqrt(80)
            ) %>%
  ungroup()



```

# Recognition Plot

```{r}

# change factor order
four_row_data$studied_vs_lure <- factor(four_row_data$studied_vs_lure, levels = c("studied", "lure")) 


plot2=ggplot(four_row_data, 
       aes(x=studied_vs_lure,y=mean_old,fill=production)) +
  stat_summary(geom = "bar", fun = mean, position=position_dodge(width=0.9)) +
  stat_summary(geom = "errorbar", width = .3, fun.data = mean_se, position = position_dodge(width=.9)) +
  scale_x_discrete(name=NULL,labels=c("Studied Words","Critical Lures")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name="Proportion of 'Old' Responses", breaks= seq(0,1,0.1),expand = c(0,0)) +  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=FA_rate, linetype="dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(name=NULL,labels=c("Aloud","Silent"),
                    values = c("#387db5", "#afd3f0")) +
  theme(legend.position = c(.8,.9),panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # blank aesthetics
        panel.background = element_blank(), text = element_text(size=12),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill="transparent", colour="white", linewidth = 1),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black",size=12),
        axis.line = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
        axis.ticks.length=unit(-0.2, "cm"),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

plot2

ggsave("e2_plot.tiff")

```
